name: section
title: Section
description: A painted content region (<section>, named by its title). Variants plain / card / muted, padding none–lg (scalar or per-breakpoint object from base through 2xl), optional dividers between children, and a header slot with title, description and actions. Responsive padding updates root, header, body and divided header spacing together. Scalar lg remains p-6 sm:p-8; an explicit sm entry overrides sm:p-8. Static literal tables keep every class visible to Tailwind.
author: gntik-ai
